verdict.rationale: Restate's GitHub README lists official SDKs for TypeScript, Java/Kotlin, Python, Go and Rust, and the docs reference Go and Rust SDK clients and patterns across TypeScript, Python, Java and Go, so multi-language workflow authoring is clearly delivered. Feature parity across those SDKs is not documented; most of the detailed feature docs in the pack are TypeScript-specific. missing for 10: documented feature-parity matrix across SDKs, per-language docs for durable steps/timers/testing beyond TypeScript, independent hands-on corroboration of non-TS SDKs

support.subject: As a backend developer, I author workflows in the language my team already uses — TypeScript, Python, Go, or more — with real feature parity across SDKs

citations.quote: Restate supports the following SDKs: * [Typescript] * [Java and Kotlin] * [Python] * [Go] * [Rust]
AI agent integration patterns across TypeScript, Python, Java, and Go.
The Go SDK client library lets you invoke Restate handlers from anywhere in your application.
